dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies such as the Army Corps of Engineers and the Bonneville Power Administration, regional power users, navigation operators, and communities along the Lower Snake River system in Washington.
dimensions.evidence: meaning the following dams in the State of Washington... Ice Harbor Dam... Lower Monumental Dam... Little Goose Dam... Lower Granite Dam.

dimensions.assessment: Permanently blocks any federal study or action related to breaching or altering the four dams, and alters approval requirements for spillage operations.
dimensions.evidence: No Federal funds may be used to allow, lead to, or study the breach or functional alteration... of... the Lower Snake River dams.

dimensions.assessment: Prohibits the use of federal funds for specific studies and activities, though overall monetary savings or costs are not quantified.
dimensions.evidence: No Federal funds may be used to allow, lead to, or study the breach or functional alteration

dimensions.assessment: Applies specific restrictions to four named federal dams and their operational procedures under the Department of the Army and Bonneville Power Administration.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Army, acting through the Chief of Engineers, may not carry out any spillage operations on any of the Lower Snake River dams

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a permanent statutory restriction on the use of federal funds for these activities and operations.
dimensions.evidence: No Federal funds may be used to allow, lead to, or study the breach or functional alteration

missing_information: Specific budgetary allocations currently tied to studies of the Lower Snake River dams.
importance_detail.rationale: Prohibits the use of federal funds for breaching, altering, studying, or providing technical assistance for removing the Lower Snake River dams, and restricts related spillage operations.
